catalog_target.note: Capacity is accepted only after live load testing on the intended infrastructure.

requirements_for_medium_and_above.sessions: shared session storage required for more than one application node
requirements_for_medium_and_above.database: dedicated MySQL/MariaDB with tuned InnoDB buffer pool and slow-query monitoring
requirements_for_medium_and_above.http: Nginx or equivalent reverse proxy, HTTP/2 or HTTP/3, Brotli/gzip and static asset caching
requirements_for_medium_and_above.workers: separate long-running queue workers with process supervision
requirements_for_medium_and_above.cdn: recommended for media and static assets
